articles.title: Cboe, S&P Dow Jones may explore tokenized options contracts under extended licensing deal
articles.snippet: The agreement opens the door to tokenized derivatives as some of Wall Street's biggest institutions, including Nasdaq, NYSE and DTCC, move traditional markets onchain.

articles.title: Democrats killed the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: Democrats should remember the people they represent and do what's best for them, not what's best for their political calculus, consultants, and special interests, writes Sen. Tim Scott (R-S.C.).

articles.title: Zcash developers begin moving Tachyon code into faster private-payment software
articles.snippet: Developers are starting to fold Project Tachyon into Zakura Common as they work toward a long-term target of more than 50,000 private payments a second.

articles.title: Anthropic plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure. Pre-IPO perps barely blink.
articles.snippet: Anthropic's prospectus seen by Reuters shows big spending plans despite heavy losses. Still, pre-IPO perps barely moved on cryptocurrency exchanges.

articles.title: Bitcoin holds $83,000 as ZEC drops 12% and oil climbs again
articles.snippet: Global stocks fell to a one-week low as Brent rose for a second day and traders added to bets on more Federal Reserve rate hikes ahead of Wednesday's PCE inflation data.
